capability: Touching pairs pull a nudged shape back home
title: Let every join pull back.

hook.picture: Close on the whale nudging a tightly knotted line. The knot springs out of shape and does not come back to its outline.
hook.words: One small nudge, and the shape wanders off.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I nudged the model, and it never settled back.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three more nudges, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each knot wanders, and nothing pulls its parts back.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Nothing tells each part where its neighbours are.

stakes.body: Every small change sends the model wandering, so hours go into hand-fixing shapes that should hold on their own.

solution_hint: Let each touching pair pull together.

metaphor.body: The line is a molecule's chain, folded into a knot. Wherever two parts of the chain touch, a join pulls them together; let go, and all the joins pull the knot back into its outline.

steps.picture: Dashed joins appear wherever two parts of the chain touch in the outline. Stretched joins glow rust.
steps.words: Each touching pair pulls back together.

steps.picture: The whale lets go. Every stretched join tugs its two ends together, with a ring pulse at each. The knot slides inward.
steps.words: Where parts touch is a seam.

steps.picture: Push-in on the last stretched join. Its glow goes from rust to teal, and the knot locks into its outline pin.
steps.sound: The last string snaps into tune.

steps.picture: A small stretch counter falls toward empty as the line goes still.
steps.words: Total stretch falls toward zero. Then stillness.
steps.sound: A falling glide that lands on the home note.

real_case.claim: Six folds were loaded from RCSB. Heat flow on the sheaf-Laplacian energy returns a 0.4 A-perturbed native to E~0 and RMSD < 0.2 A.

honest_limit.picture: A loose string of beads with no outline and no joins drawn. The whale lets go, and nothing happens. There are no touching pairs to pull.
honest_limit.words: No known shape? There is nothing to pull.

not_this.body: Not folding from scratch. Settling a known shape.

ending_pattern.body: The FELT nudge replays, and now the touching joins pull the knot back into its outline every time, even under a harder push.
ending_pattern.callback: The loop that sprang loose in bar 2 springs back into the same outline, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Know which parts touch. Let them pull.

The whale nudges again to fix it. The knot drifts further off.
beats.words: It never finds its way back.

beats.picture: The whale looks at the loose knot outside its outline. Hold.
Half a bar of stillness, then SERIES.open and the title.

beats.picture: Same close framing as bar 1. The whale nudges the same loop; the joins glow, tug, and the knot slides back into its outline. The pod answers ✓.

beats.picture: The whale nudges harder. The knot still returns. Spark.
The knot at rest in its outline, the whale breathing.

beats.sound: Lockup sting, then the room tone tail.
